SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q20. “Globalisation has been advantageous to consumers.” Which of the following 
statements supports this?  
(A) There is a greater choice before these consumers.  
(B) They enjoy improved quality and lower prices.  
(C) Standard of living has raised.  
(D) All of the above.

Answer / Solution:
“Globalisation has been advantageous to consumers.” Support this. 
(D) All of the above. 
Reasoning: It offers choice, lower prices, and better quality.
